items.headline: Gap and Royce tenant improvements permitted at Stevens Creek Boulevard retail site
items.summary: Two retail tenant-improvement permits at 2855 Stevens Creek Boulevard were issued the same day: a $1.7 million buildout for Gap and a $275,000 buildout for Royce.

items.headline: Rooftop solar install permitted for Ise Labs office building
items.summary: A $930,575 rooftop photovoltaic installation was permitted for the Ise Labs Inc office at 2201 Qume Drive.
